title: 修复跨分支构建污染并交付可重复制品
source: 独立编审：交付控制面根因
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
rubric: 证明该交付根因
阻断受影响发布
验证故障条件被覆盖
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台提供Git、Python及本地双分支构建素材；隔离临时目录，无真实CI凭据。

## 操作任务
实现build.py中的build(repo, revision, output) -> 固定commit SHA。平台用素材创建真实Git仓库，分支A生成legacy.js，分支B不再生成它，但业务pipeline.py不主动清dist。你的CI入口必须为每次执行创建隔离输入/构建目录，以所选提交而非当前脏工作区为源，执行提交内pipeline.py，再打包实际dist产物。禁止修改题给pipeline或清理/切换共享原仓库；用户未跟踪文件和当前HEAD都要保留。支持并行两个构建，不能串分支。
输出ZIP只含dist/下实际文件和manifest.json；manifest={"commit":"解析后的SHA","files":{"相对dist路径":"内容SHA256"}}。同一提交多次构建ZIP字节一致，不能把源码当成构建产物。参考产物固定ZIP日期/权限，但允许其他能保证可复现的等价方法。
失败（无效提交、构建退出非0、空dist）应抛异常，已存在的输出必须原字节保留；成功用完整新制品替换输出，临时文件回收。output必须在原仓库之外，不能是符号链接。提交名为空、以-开头或含NUL无效。素材均为本地可信教学构建程序，不访问网络/远程仓库；不要求运行Jenkins控制器。

## 产物
build.py完整构建入口。

## 验收方法
真正创建Git提交并执行业务构建，比较A后B/干净B、并发A/B、脏工作区保护、逐文件摘要和ZIP可复现性；失败和空产物阻断且原输出保持。只覆盖构建阶段，不声称Jenkins CPS或线上部署验证。

files.fixtures/incident.txt: A build leaves dist/legacy.js. B pipeline writes new files but does not delete old generated files. Repository working tree is shared and may be dirty. Do not alter the project pipeline to conceal the CI isolation defect.

exercise.environment: isolated-local-git-python-build
exercise.operation:
实现build.py中的build(repo, revision, output) -> 固定commit SHA。平台用素材创建真实Git仓库，分支A生成legacy.js，分支B不再生成它，但业务pipeline.py不主动清dist。你的CI入口必须为每次执行创建隔离输入/构建目录，以所选提交而非当前脏工作区为源，执行提交内pipeline.py，再打包实际dist产物。禁止修改题给pipeline或清理/切换共享原仓库；用户未跟踪文件和当前HEAD都要保留。支持并行两个构建，不能串分支。
输出ZIP只含dist/下实际文件和manifest.json；manifest={"commit":"解析后的SHA","files":{"相对dist路径":"内容SHA256"}}。同一提交多次构建ZIP字节一致，不能把源码当成构建产物。参考产物固定ZIP日期/权限，但允许其他能保证可复现的等价方法。
失败（无效提交、构建退出非0、空dist）应抛异常，已存在的输出必须原字节保留；成功用完整新制品替换输出，临时文件回收。output必须在原仓库之外，不能是符号链接。提交名为空、以-开头或含NUL无效。素材均为本地可信教学构建程序，不访问网络/远程仓库；不要求运行Jenkins控制器。
exercise.verification: Native Git commits and actual build subprocesses; artifact content/concurrent isolation/failure preservation. No Jenkins controller or deployment.

test_files.checks/check.py:
import concurrent.futures,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile,zipfile,time
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/pipeline.py': '5adbaf12ac1b82084c619526da1a489806ef2c15a0df29102ebfc5acc0e4adad', 'fixtures/assets-a.json': '81f3549a6fb173b9afd2d1674b61af0ef05dfad5ac353de130ac34db4e5797d9', 'fixtures/assets-b.json': 'aab1f697eef24a88e78ff270dbd43710e0219e11274aef9c1ae0765b1e61f0ec', 'fixtures/incident.txt': 'ac680b532d8aecbf8106781478c237551b0bc9a5d492fc40e73488485ca8843b'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly build fixture changed'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('learner_build',ROOT/'build.py');task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
def git(repo,*args):
    p=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],capture_output=True,timeout=15);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr;return p.stdout.decode('utf8').strip()
def inspect(path,commit,expected):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as bundle:
        names=bundle.namelist();assert len(names)==len(set(names)) and set(names)=={'manifest.json',*('dist/'+n for n in expected)},names
        manifest=json.loads(bundle.read('manifest.json'));assert manifest=={'commit':commit,'files':{n:hashlib.sha256(b.encode()).hexdigest() for n,b in expected.items()}}
        for name,body in expected.items():assert bundle.read('dist/'+name)==body.encode('utf8'),name
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-ci-case-') as directory:
    root=pathlib.Path(directory);repo=root/'source repo';repo.mkdir();git(repo,'init','-q');git(repo,'config','user.name','Fixture');git(repo,'config','user.email','fixture@example.invalid');git(repo,'config','core.autocrlf','false')
    (repo/'pipeline.py').write_bytes((ROOT/'fixtures/pipeline.py').read_bytes())
    (repo/'assets.json').write_bytes((ROOT/'fixtures/assets-a.json').read_bytes());git(repo,'add','.');git(repo,'commit','-qm','A');sha_a=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD');git(repo,'branch','branch-a')
    (repo/'assets.json').write_bytes((ROOT/'fixtures/assets-b.json').read_bytes());git(repo,'commit','-qam','B');sha_b=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD');git(repo,'branch','branch-b')
    expected_a=json.loads((ROOT/'fixtures/assets-a.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))['assets'];expected_b=json.loads((ROOT/'fixtures/assets-b.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))['assets']
    # Deliberately untracked generated data and unrelated dirty source must survive untouched.
    (repo/'dist').mkdir();(repo/'dist/old-secret.txt').write_text('KEEP-LOCAL',encoding='utf8');(repo/'sentinel.txt').write_text('DO-NOT-TOUCH',encoding='utf8')
    (repo/'assets.json').write_text(json.dumps({'assets':{'injected.txt':'DIRTY'}}),encoding='utf8')
    before=(git(repo,'status','--porcelain'),git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD'),(repo/'assets.json').read_bytes(),(repo/'dist/old-secret.txt').read_bytes())
    def run(rev,name,want,sha):
        out=root/name;assert task.build(str(repo),rev,str(out))==sha;inspect(out,sha,want);return out.read_bytes()
    run('branch-a','A.zip',expected_a,sha_a);after_a=run('branch-b','B-after-A.zip',expected_b,sha_b)
    time.sleep(2.2)  # ZIP DOS timestamps have two-second granularity; don't accidentally accept wall-clock packaging.
    assert run(sha_b,'clean-B.zip',expected_b,sha_b)==after_a,'same commit must be byte-reproducible, independent of previous runs'
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        fa=pool.submit(run,sha_a,'parallel-A.zip',expected_a,sha_a);fb=pool.submit(run,sha_b,'parallel-B.zip',expected_b,sha_b);fa.result();assert fb.result()==after_a
    assert (git(repo,'status','--porcelain'),git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD'),(repo/'assets.json').read_bytes(),(repo/'dist/old-secret.txt').read_bytes())==before,'shared checkout changed'
    assert (repo/'sentinel.txt').read_text()=='DO-NOT-TOUCH'
    # A successful process with no output is not publishable; failures cannot overwrite approved artifacts.
    git(repo,'checkout','--','assets.json')
    for label,config in [('failed',{'assets':{'partial.txt':'partial'},'fail_build':True}),('empty',{'assets':{}})]:
        (repo/'assets.json').write_text(json.dumps(config),encoding='utf8');git(repo,'commit','-qam',label);sha=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD');target=root/(label+'.zip');target.write_bytes(b'APPROVED-OLD')
        try:task.build(str(repo),sha,str(target))
        except Exception:pass
        else:raise AssertionError(label+' build was accepted')
        assert target.read_bytes()==b'APPROVED-OLD'
    target=root/'invalid.zip';target.write_bytes(b'OLD')
    for rev in ('does-not-exist','--help',''):
        try:task.build(str(repo),rev,str(target))
        except Exception:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('invalid revision accepted')
        assert target.read_bytes()==b'OLD'
    sentinel=repo/'sentinel.txt';old=sentinel.read_bytes()
    try:task.build(str(repo),sha_b,str(sentinel))
    except Exception:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('source repository output accepted')
    assert sentinel.read_bytes()==old
    link=root/'linked-output.zip';outside=root/'approved-target.zip';outside.write_bytes(b'UNCHANGED-TARGET')
    try:link.symlink_to(outside)
    except (OSError,NotImplementedError):pass  # Windows may lack symlink privilege; native Linux must exercise it.
    else:
        try:task.build(str(repo),sha_b,str(link))
        except Exception:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('symlink output accepted')
        assert link.is_symlink() and outside.read_bytes()==b'UNCHANGED-TARGET'
    directory_output=root/'not-a-file';directory_output.mkdir();(directory_output/'keep').write_bytes(b'KEEP')
    try:task.build(str(repo),sha_b,str(directory_output))
    except Exception:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('directory output accepted')
    assert (directory_output/'keep').read_bytes()==b'KEEP'
    assert not list(root.glob('.build-*')),'temporary publish artifact leaked'
print('Real Git commits + executed build outputs: A/B reuse, dirty source exclusion, concurrent isolation, deterministic package and failure-safe publication passed; Jenkins controller not exercised')

title: 修复零测试假绿与过期报告放行的流水线门禁
source: 独立编审：交付控制面根因
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
rubric: 证明该交付根因
阻断受影响发布
验证故障条件被覆盖

files.fixtures/incident.txt: Report output moved from old-reports/ to renamed-tests/. Legacy collector treated unmatched reports and zero tests as success. Only current invocation reports may authorize publication.

exercise.environment: isolated-python-unittest-ci-gate
exercise.operation:
修复 gate.py 的 gate(command, receipt, timeout=3)。command 是可信教学测试命令 argv 列表，必须实际启动一次；为每次调用创建新的私有报告目录，以 OPSF_REPORT_DIR 环境变量传给进程。报告路径已改名，需递归收集本次目录下 *.xml，不能读旧工作区报告。超时或非0退出必须失败；测试进程即使退出0，其报告也必须独立判断。
支持本题无 XML 命名空间的 testsuite/testsuites 嵌套，按实际 testcase 节点统计，不重复累计父子 suite 的 tests。任意 failure/error 失败；按 (classname默认为空,name) 唯一识别用例，name非空，跨报告重复失败。允许 skipped，但至少1个未跳过测试；空报告集合、0测试、全跳过、坏XML、声明tests/skipped/failures/errors与后代实际用例数量不符都失败。计数属性若存在必须ASCII非负整数字符串；未声明允许。DOCTYPE/ENTITY、未知元素、非普通文件和超过1MiB报告拒绝。允许元素为 testsuites/testsuite/testcase/skipped/failure/error/system-out/system-err/properties/property。
成功返回并原子保存 {"tests":总用例数,"executed":非跳过数,"skipped":跳过数,"reports":{"报告相对路径":"原始字节SHA256"}} 到 receipt。失败抛异常，原批准收据必须保持原字节；receipt不能为链接或目录。无论成功失败都回收私有报告目录和发布临时文件，不删除旧报告或改动题给测试程序。平台提供真实本地 Python unittest 进程；此题验本地流水线门禁，不声称已运行 Jenkins/CPS 或生产发布。
合法UTF-8及UTF-16 XML均应支持；DTD/ENTITY禁令按XML声明语义判断，不能仅在原始字节里搜索ASCII文本。
exercise.verification: Actual test subprocesses and fresh JUnit reports; failure-preserving gate receipt, no Jenkins controller/deployment.

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys,tempfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/test_runner.py': '47c28e6ada6e6bfc9b4931d1f7cc09cc52c8f526daf218c72eba488e87da8d7e', 'fixtures/incident.txt': '895270a284eaa3150c426e1c82732db7a5775cd8c17b611fab889717ab96d37f'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly fixture changed'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('learner_gate',ROOT/'gate.py');task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-ci-tests-') as directory:
    root=pathlib.Path(directory);receipt=root/'approved.json';runner=str((ROOT/'fixtures/test_runner.py').resolve())
    stale=root/'old-reports';stale.mkdir();stale_data=b'<testsuite tests="1"><testcase classname="Old" name="stale"/></testsuite>';(stale/'result.xml').write_bytes(stale_data)
    seen=[]
    for mode,expected in [('pass',(2,2,0)),('nested',(3,2,1)),('utf16',(2,2,0)),('pass',(2,2,0))]:
        marker=root/(mode+str(len(seen))+'.json');result=task.gate([sys.executable,'-B',runner,mode,str(marker)],str(receipt))
        assert all(type(result[key]) is int for key in ('tests','executed','skipped')),'receipt counters must be JSON integers'
        assert (result['tests'],result['executed'],result['skipped'])==expected
        assert json.loads(receipt.read_text())==result
        assert set(result['reports'])=={'renamed-tests/results.xml'}
        xml=ET.Element('testsuite',tests=str(expected[0]),failures='0',errors='0',skipped=str(expected[2]))
        for case_name in ['test_sum','test_branch']+(['test_optional']if mode=='nested'else[]):
            case=ET.SubElement(xml,'testcase',classname='Smoke',name=case_name)
            if case_name=='test_optional':ET.SubElement(case,'skipped')
        if mode=='nested':
            outer=ET.Element('testsuites',tests=str(expected[0]));outer.append(xml);xml=outer
        xml_bytes=ET.tostring(xml,encoding='utf8')
        if mode=='utf16':xml_bytes=('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>'+xml_bytes.decode('utf8').split('?>',1)[-1]).encode('utf-16')
        assert result['reports']['renamed-tests/results.xml']==hashlib.sha256(xml_bytes).hexdigest(),'receipt digest is not actual report bytes' 
        report_dir=pathlib.Path(json.loads(marker.read_text())['report_dir']);assert report_dir not in seen and report_dir!=stale;seen.append(report_dir)
        assert not report_dir.exists(),'private reports not cleaned'
    approved=receipt.read_bytes()
    for mode in ('missing','zero','skip','fail','crash','nonzero-report','malformed','duplicate','counter','doctype','utf16-doctype','oversized','unknown','timeout'):
        marker=root/(mode+'.json');raised=False
        try:task.gate([sys.executable,'-B',runner,mode,str(marker)],str(receipt),timeout=.2 if mode=='timeout' else 3)
        except Exception:raised=True
        assert raised,mode+' incorrectly authorized'
        assert receipt.read_bytes()==approved,'failed run replaced approved receipt: '+mode
        if marker.exists():assert not pathlib.Path(json.loads(marker.read_text())['report_dir']).exists(),'failed-run reports leaked'
    target_dir=root/'directory-target';target_dir.mkdir();(target_dir/'keep').write_text('KEEP')
    raised=False
    try:task.gate([sys.executable,'-B',runner,'pass',str(root/'target-dir-marker')],str(target_dir))
    except Exception:raised=True
    assert raised and (target_dir/'keep').read_text()=='KEEP','directory receipt target must be preserved'
    assert (stale/'result.xml').read_bytes()==stale_data
    assert not list(root.glob('.gate-*')),'publication temporary leaked'
print('actual test execution, fresh report discovery, nested counters, failure closure and atomic receipt checks passed')

title: 修复Operator无变化仍写status的自触发忙循环
source: 独立编审：控制器特有故障根因
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
rubric: 证明具体协调机制故障
保护对象身份与数据
验证重启/重试后可收敛

files.fixtures/contract.txt: CR spec revision/configMap, ConfigMap data.revision; Ready reflects actual observed child data. Only semantic status changes may issue a status PUT. Preserve all unrelated status and condition data, original object spec and identity. No Deployment or controller manager exists in this isolated API exercise.

exercise.environment: isolated-native-api-etcd-go-controller
exercise.operation:
修复 controller.go 的 Reconcile(client, base, path, now) (changed bool,error)。平台提供只读 Go TLS/API 适配器与真实隔离 API/etcd，函数必须实际读取 WebApp 及同命名空间 spec.configMap 指定的 ConfigMap。以 data.revision 是否等于 spec.revision 决定 Ready：相等为 True/RevisionApplied，否则 False/RevisionMismatch；子资源404为 False/ConfigMapMissing，其他读错误必须返回错误且不写status。Ready.message固定 observed=<实际revision或空> desired=<spec.revision>。
Ready条件和status根observedGeneration反映本次读取CR的generation。Ready.lastTransitionTime只在Status字符串发生变化或首次创建时使用传入now；Reason/Message变化但Status相同要保留原时间。必须原样保留其他条件、状态扩展字段、条件顺序、spec、UID；没有Ready条件则追加一个。
只有状态语义实质变化时才PUT对象的/status（携带读取时resourceVersion），恰好一次，成功返回true。无变化返回false且零修改请求，即使时钟变了。HTTP错误返回error，不能谎报成功；此题无冲突重试要求，409须由调用者下次重新协调。不得写主资源、ConfigMap或权限；不得禁用TLS验证。平台通过真实API元数据审计统计修改请求，不能以重复PUT后resourceVersion没变假装没有写。无需用户另外打开K8s。只验协调函数、API/RBAC与status收敛，不声称有工作队列、节点、控制器管理器或Deployment。
exercise.verification: Real API status transitions and metadata audit proving zero mutating requests at steady state.

import copy,hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=Path.cwd()
def same_json(left,right):
    # JSON booleans are not numbers. Numeric formatting differences (1 vs 1.0) may remain equivalent.
    if isinstance(left,bool) or isinstance(right,bool):return type(left)is type(right) and left==right
    if isinstance(left,(int,float)) and isinstance(right,(int,float)):return left==right
    if type(left)is not type(right):return False
    if isinstance(left,dict):return left.keys()==right.keys()and all(same_json(left[k],right[k])for k in left)

controller.go；只读transport.go处理证书、API响应和CLI适配。

exercise.environment: isolated-python-credential-child-process
exercise.operation:
修复 invoke.py 的 invoke(command, token, timeout=2)，为可信教学客户端实现最小化凭据交付。command 是平台给定的绝对解释器及固定客户端 argv 列表，不经 shell；token 为12到4096个 UTF-8 字节的教学字符串，可包含中文和换行。command 必须保持原样，任何 argv 项含完整 token 时，应在启动前拒绝。不得将 token 追加到 argv、环境变量或磁盘文件，必须经子进程 stdin 原字节一次性交付并关闭输入；不可写代码绕过实际客户端调用。
启动环境只允许从父进程复制 PATH、SystemRoot、SYSTEMROOT、WINDIR、TEMP、TMP、TMPDIR；可设置 PYTHONUTF8=1 和 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8，Python解释器可能自行加入 LC_CTYPE。不得复制其他父环境，包括别的服务凭据；允许字段若含 token 也不得传播。禁止修改父进程环境和传入 command 列表。平台提供真实子进程及采样记录，可以核实 argv/env/stdin 哈希；不要求用户外开 Jenkins，也不声称本题检查了真实 agent 全部进程或有权限读取进程内存的攻击者。
客户端会把教学密钥同时写到 stdout/stderr，必须捕获且丢弃这两路原始输出，调用者控制台、异常字符串及标准 traceback、返回结果中不能出现完整 token。成功退出0返回 {"exit_code":0}；非0、启动失败或超时抛出无秘密的异常，确保本次客户端结束。不能因打印星号就保留原始 stderr 在异常链中。本题客户端不会派生孙进程。学生不编写真实凭据轮换脚本，事故中实际泄露的生产凭据仍应由授权流程撤销。

def require_exited(pid):
    # Inspect only the learner's own teaching child, and clean a wrong implementation before failing.
    if os.name=='nt':
        import ctypes
        kernel=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
        kernel.OpenProcess.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
        kernel.GetExitCodeProcess.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulong)]
        kernel.TerminateProcess.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_uint]
        kernel.WaitForSingleObject.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_uint]
        kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]
        handle=kernel.OpenProcess(0x1000|0x0001|0x00100000,False,pid)
        if not handle:return
        try:
            code=ctypes.c_ulong();assert kernel.GetExitCodeProcess(handle,ctypes.byref(code))
            alive=code.value==259
            if alive:kernel.TerminateProcess(handle,1);kernel.WaitForSingleObject(handle,2000)
        finally:kernel.CloseHandle(handle)
    else:
        import signal
        try:os.kill(pid,0)
        except ProcessLookupError:return
        alive=True
        try:os.kill(pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:pass
        try:os.waitpid(pid,0)
        except ChildProcessError:pass
    assert not alive,'teaching child remains alive after invoke returned/raised'

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='credential-channel-') as directory:
    root=pathlib.Path(directory);child=str((ROOT/'fixtures/noisy_client.py').resolve())

exercise.environment: isolated-python-dependency-install-cache
exercise.operation:
修复 dependencies.py 的 dependencies(lock, store, cache, output, toolchain, platform, timeout=2)。这是实际执行本地教学安装器并缓存已安装依赖 ZIP 的流水线练习，不声称运行 pip/npm 解析或真实编译器。readonly fixtures/install.py 从平台 store 中读取包字节、核对锁定摘要、产生 environment.json 与 packages/<name>.pkg；不得修改安装器或锁文件。toolchain/platform 是可信非空版本身份字符串，既参与缓存键又必须与制品元数据一致。
lock 是 UTF-8 JSON，packages 为1到20个对象；name 使用 [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]* 且不重复，sha256 是小写64位摘要。缓存键为对 {"lock_sha256":原始锁文件字节SHA256,"toolchain":toolchain,"platform":platform} 进行键排序、无空白、ensure_ascii=False 的 UTF-8 JSON 的 SHA256。缓存文件只能是 cache/<key>.zip；不能仅用OS、不能读fallback旧键。返回 {"key":键,"hit":本次是否命中布尔值,"sha256":最终ZIP字节SHA256}。
命中时不运行安装器，必须读取真实 ZIP 并核对包集合、每包内容摘要、environment.json 精确的工具链/平台对象。ZIP 成员只能为 environment.json 和锁文件对应的包；重复成员、额外路径、加密项、任意成员展开超1MiB或压缩包超8MiB均拒绝。缓存校验失败抛异常，不悄悄重装掩盖污染，也不能覆盖当前 output。这里校验的是缓存内容符合可信锁文件和身份，不声称自描述元数据提供发布者签名认证。
未命中时实际启动固定安装器一次：解释器为当前 Python，argv 依次为 fixtures/install.py、lock绝对路径、store绝对路径、私有临时ZIP路径、toolchain、platform。非0/超时失败；完成后先同样验证ZIP，再原子写缓存与 output。无论命中或未命中，都只有验证完成才原子替换 output；任何失败保留原output且不生成新键的伪成功缓存。目标output和本次cache entry为符号链接或非普通文件时拒绝；父目录可信，不要求恶意并发替换防护。本题不要求多个写入者同时写同一个键，缓存与output不构成跨文件事务；已校验成功的缓存即使输出写入失败仍可保留。临时文件和安装工作目录应回收。

import hashlib,importlib.util,io,json,pathlib,tempfile,zipfile
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/install.py': 'fdc63533d12701058806db6d91fdb5fd05839ef3be828ea571629a1edd37841f', 'fixtures/incident.txt': 'd12465b7918c636481cad5126518eb887fb65ee34f52ca942c78100325b0a05f'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly installer modified'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('student',ROOT/'dependencies.py');student=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(student)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='dependency-contract-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);store=root/'store';store.mkdir();cache=root/'cache';out=root/'environment.zip';lock=root/'lock.json'
 def calls():return len((store/'calls.log').read_text().splitlines()) if (store/'calls.log').exists() else 0
 def setup(data):
    (store/'lib.pkg').write_bytes(data);lock.write_text(json.dumps({'packages':[{'name':'lib','sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}]}),encoding='utf8')
 def expected(tool,platform):
    value={'lock_sha256':hashlib.sha256(lock.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'toolchain':tool,'platform':platform}
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
 def invoke(tool='runtime-1',platform='linux-amd64',hit=False):
    before=calls();raw=lock.read_bytes();result=student.dependencies(str(lock),str(store),str(cache),str(out),tool,platform)
    key=expected(tool,platform);assert result['key']==key and result['hit'] is hit
    assert result['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest() and out.read_bytes()==(cache/(key+'.zip')).read_bytes()
    assert calls()==before+(0 if hit else 1),'must run installer on miss only'
    assert lock.read_bytes()==raw
    with zipfile.ZipFile(out) as archive:
        assert json.loads(archive.read('environment.json'))=={'toolchain':tool,'platform':platform}
        assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read('packages/lib.pkg')).hexdigest()==json.loads(raw)['packages'][0]['sha256']
    return key
 setup(b'lib-version-one');first=invoke();invoke(hit=True)
 setup(b'lib-version-two');second=invoke();assert second!=first
 third=invoke(tool='runtime-2');fourth=invoke(platform='linux-arm64');assert len({first,second,third,fourth})==4
 # A hit remains usable when the installer source is unavailable: cache content itself must be checked.
 (store/'lib.pkg').unlink();invoke(hit=True);previous=out.read_bytes();entry=cache/(second+'.zip');good=entry.read_bytes();before=calls()
 def rejected():
    failed=False
    try:student.dependencies(str(lock),str(store),str(cache),str(out),'runtime-1','linux-amd64')
    except Exception:failed=True
    assert failed and out.read_bytes()==previous and calls()==before,'corrupt cache must fail closed without a hidden rebuild'
 for mode in ('wrong-package','wrong-toolchain','extra-member','duplicate-member','broken-zip','oversized-metadata','oversized-archive'):
    buffer=io.BytesIO()
    if mode=='broken-zip':entry.write_bytes(b'bad archive')
    elif mode=='oversized-archive':entry.write_bytes(b'P'*(8*1024*1024)+good)
    else:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(good)) as old,zipfile.ZipFile(buffer,'w') as changed:
            for name in old.namelist():
                data=old.read(name)
                if name=='packages/lib.pkg' and mode=='wrong-package':data=b'poisoned package'
                if name=='environment.json' and mode=='oversized-metadata':data+=b' '*1048576
                if name=='environment.json' and mode=='wrong-toolchain':data=b'{"toolchain":"runtime-old","platform":"linux-amd64"}'
                changed.writestr(name,data)
            if mode=='extra-member':changed.writestr('../unexpected',b'outside')
            if mode=='duplicate-member':changed.writestr('packages/lib.pkg',old.read('packages/lib.pkg'))
        entry.write_bytes(buffer.getvalue())
    rejected()
 entry.write_bytes(good);setup(b'third-new-lock');newkey=expected('runtime-1','linux-amd64')
 for flag,timeout in [('FAIL',2),('SLOW',.3)]:
    (store/flag).write_text('1');failed=False
    try:student.dependencies(str(lock),str(store),str(cache),str(out),'runtime-1','linux-amd64',timeout=timeout)
    except Exception:failed=True
    finally:(store/flag).unlink()
    assert failed and out.read_bytes()==previous and not (cache/(newkey+'.zip')).exists(),'failed installation published an artifact'
 assert not list(root.rglob('.dependencies-*'))
print('actual dependency installer, lock/toolchain/platform cache separation, verified hit reuse, poison closure and failed-install preservation passed')

body:
## 操作任务
修复 pod.json 与 client.py。事故包含两个独立阻断：投射给 Kubernetes API 的 token 错误地使用外部服务 audience；常驻客户端只在启动时读取 token，文件轮换后仍用旧值。平台自动提供隔离真实 kube-apiserver/etcd、同名重建的教学 ServiceAccount 和只读 ConfigMap 权限，不需要你另外打开或搭建 Kubernetes。
pod.json 仅可修改两项 serviceAccountToken.audience：kube.token 应为 https://kubernetes.default.svc；vault.token 必须保留 https://vault.training.invalid。其余资源身份、只读挂载、路径、600秒有效期、安全上下文和 automountServiceAccountToken=false 均保持，不得混用两种受众、扩大 RBAC 或使用管理员 kubeconfig。平台实际提交该 Pod 清单做 API 校验，但不会启动镜像、kubelet或控制器；签发与文件替换由教学夹具根据配置显式执行，不能当作已证明 kubelet 自动投射或周期轮换。
实现 APIClient(base_url, ca_file, token_file) 和 get(path)。每次 get 都重新读取 UTF-8 token 文件并去掉首尾空白，以 Bearer 发送一次 GET 到指定本地 API路径。用给定 ca_file 验证 TLS，不依赖用户的默认 kubeconfig、环境代理或客户端管理员证书；path必须以单斜线开头。HTTP结果返回 (整数状态码, JSON对象)，包括401和403；网络/TLS错误抛异常。不要输出完整token。平台会让同一个客户端进程经历正确API令牌、错误audience、无效令牌、删除重建同名SA导致旧UID令牌失效、换入新文件；新令牌应恢复原有单个ConfigMap读取，其他Secret与跨命名空间请求始终403。
保留真实认证与授权的区别：401先修令牌目标/有效性；403不能通过偷换默认身份处理。教学身份为 system:serviceaccount:training:viewer。完整令牌仅存在临时文件/子进程内，不写题目答案或日志。

## 产物
pod.json 与 client.py，分别交付双受众投射配置及能读取轮换令牌的常驻客户端。

## 验收方法
真正签发两种JWT并TokenReview交叉验证；真实API GET检验200/401/403、同名SA不同UID和错误CA。禁止管理员凭据替换及扩大现有权限。

撤销传播由平台独立客户端有界等待确认后再验收，不要求学员假定删除ServiceAccount立即使每次请求返回401。

exercise.operation:
修复 pod.json 与 client.py。事故包含两个独立阻断：投射给 Kubernetes API 的 token 错误地使用外部服务 audience；常驻客户端只在启动时读取 token，文件轮换后仍用旧值。平台自动提供隔离真实 kube-apiserver/etcd、同名重建的教学 ServiceAccount 和只读 ConfigMap 权限，不需要你另外打开或搭建 Kubernetes。
pod.json 仅可修改两项 serviceAccountToken.audience：kube.token 应为 https://kubernetes.default.svc；vault.token 必须保留 https://vault.training.invalid。其余资源身份、只读挂载、路径、600秒有效期、安全上下文和 automountServiceAccountToken=false 均保持，不得混用两种受众、扩大 RBAC 或使用管理员 kubeconfig。平台实际提交该 Pod 清单做 API 校验，但不会启动镜像、kubelet或控制器；签发与文件替换由教学夹具根据配置显式执行，不能当作已证明 kubelet 自动投射或周期轮换。
实现 APIClient(base_url, ca_file, token_file) 和 get(path)。每次 get 都重新读取 UTF-8 token 文件并去掉首尾空白，以 Bearer 发送一次 GET 到指定本地 API路径。用给定 ca_file 验证 TLS，不依赖用户的默认 kubeconfig、环境代理或客户端管理员证书；path必须以单斜线开头。HTTP结果返回 (整数状态码, JSON对象)，包括401和403；网络/TLS错误抛异常。不要输出完整token。平台会让同一个客户端进程经历正确API令牌、错误audience、无效令牌、删除重建同名SA导致旧UID令牌失效、换入新文件；新令牌应恢复原有单个ConfigMap读取，其他Secret与跨命名空间请求始终403。
保留真实认证与授权的区别：401先修令牌目标/有效性；403不能通过偷换默认身份处理。教学身份为 system:serviceaccount:training:viewer。完整令牌仅存在临时文件/子进程内，不写题目答案或日志。
exercise.verification: 实际API签发/认证/RBAC及客户端进程读取轮换文件；不含kubelet投射、容器或控制器运行。

KUBE='https://kubernetes.default.svc'
EXTERNAL='https://vault.training.invalid'
import copy,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,select,shutil,ssl,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,urllib.error,urllib.request
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/client_driver.py': '8c333a677aaa45ad929f7fd5a3cf3bb7bc8d97e6b5179cedecbf96272e1635c2', 'fixtures/incident.txt': '70fb1116f2f604a56615d51158e482d083b1af56a0bda7f848fd2aff621ee18f', 'fixtures/api-contract.json': 'c4a9e6add0c341bc6143443912e855004e74f8f66d26d290e10b1230e0ee6750'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly fixture modified'
def pairs(items):
    value={}
    for key,v in items:assert key not in value,'duplicate JSON key';value[key]=v
    return value
pod=json.loads((ROOT/'pod.json').read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs);baseline={'apiVersion': 'v1', 'kind': 'Pod', 'metadata': {'name': 'api-reader', 'namespace': 'training'}, 'spec': {'serviceAccountName': 'viewer', 'automountServiceAccountToken': False, 'containers': [{'name': 'client', 'image': 'example.invalid/teaching-client:fixture', 'resources': {'requests': {'cpu': '10m', 'memory': '16Mi'}, 'limits': {'cpu': '100m', 'memory': '32Mi'}}, 'securityContext': {'runAsNonRoot': True, 'runAsUser': 1000, 'allowPrivilegeEscalation': False, 'capabilities': {'drop': ['ALL']}}, 'volumeMounts': [{'name': 'tokens', 'mountPath': '/var/run/teaching-tokens', 'readOnly': True}]}], 'volumes': [{'name': 'tokens', 'projected': {'sources': [{'serviceAccountToken': {'audience': 'https://vault.training.invalid', 'expirationSeconds': 600, 'path': 'kube.token'}}, {'serviceAccountToken': {'audience': 'https://vault.training.invalid', 'expirationSeconds': 600, 'path': 'vault.token'}}]}}]}}
def masked(value):
    x=copy.deepcopy(value)
    for item in x['spec']['volumes'][0]['projected']['sources']:item['serviceAccountToken']['audience']='ignored'
    return json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
assert masked(pod)==masked(baseline),'only the two declared token audiences may change'
sources=pod['spec']['volumes'][0]['projected']['sources'];tokens={i['serviceAccountToken']['path']:i['serviceAccountToken'] for i in sources}
assert tokens['kube.token']['audience']==KUBE and tokens['vault.token']['audience']==EXTERNAL,'separate intended audiences required'
class API(ControlPlane):
    def start_process(self,name,args,limit='256MiB'):
        if name=='apiserver':args=[*args,'--api-audiences='+KUBE]
        return super().start_process(name,args,limit)
with API() as api:
    sa='/api/v1/namespaces/training/serviceaccounts';identity=api.create(sa,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ServiceAccount','metadata':{'name':'viewer'}})
    rb='/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/training'
    role={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':'viewer'},'rules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['visible'],'verbs':['get']}]}
    bind={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':'viewer'},'subjects':[{'kind':'ServiceAccount','name':'viewer','namespace':'training'}],'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':'viewer'}}
    api.create(rb+'/roles',role);api.create(rb+'/rolebindings',bind)
    marker=os.urandom(12).hex();api.create('/api/v1/namespaces/training/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'visible'},'data':{'evidence':marker}})
    accepted=api.create('/api/v1/namespaces/training/pods',pod);assert accepted['spec']['automountServiceAccountToken'] is False
    issued=[]
    def issue(audience):
        value=api.create(sa+'/viewer/token',{'apiVersion':'authentication.k8s.io/v1','kind':'TokenRequest','spec':{'audiences':[audience],'expirationSeconds':600}})
        token=value['status']['token'];issued.append(token);return token
    kube=issue(tokens['kube.token']['audience']);external=issue(tokens['vault.token']['audience'])
    for token,audience,want in [(kube,KUBE,True),(external,EXTERNAL,True),(kube,EXTERNAL,False),(external,KUBE,False)]:
        review=api.create('/apis/authentication.k8s.io/v1/tokenreviews',{'apiVersion':'authentication.k8s.io/v1','kind':'TokenReview','spec':{'token':token,'audiences':[audience]}})
        assert review['status'].get('authenticated',False) is want
        if want:assert review['status']['user']['username']=='system:serviceaccount:training:viewer'
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='token-client-actor-') as temp:
        actor=pathlib.Path(temp);ca=actor/'ca.crt';shutil.copyfile(api.root/'ca.crt',ca);tokenfile=actor/'kube.token';tokenfile.write_text(kube)
        # No admin key, kubeconfig or administrative working directory is passed to the learner.
        env={k:v for k,v in api.env.items() if not k.startswith('KUBE')};env.update(HOME=str(actor),PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
        import socket
        proxy_guard=socket.socket();proxy_guard.bind(('127.0.0.1',0))
        blocked_proxy='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(proxy_guard.getsockname()[1])
        env.update(HTTPS_PROXY=blocked_proxy,https_proxy=blocked_proxy,HTTP_PROXY=blocked_proxy,http_proxy=blocked_proxy,ALL_PROXY=blocked_proxy,all_proxy=blocked_proxy,NO_PROXY='',no_proxy='')
        def start(cafile):
            p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B',str(ROOT/'fixtures/client_driver.py'),api.url,str(cafile),str(tokenfile)],cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,bufsize=1)
            return p
        def line(p):
            # Avoid TextIO read-ahead: communicate must see every unread output byte.
            deadline=time.monotonic()+5;raw=bytearray()
            while True:
                remaining=deadline-time.monotonic()
                assert remaining>0 and select.select([p.stdout],[],[],remaining)[0],'client response timeout'
                chunk=os.read(p.stdout.fileno(),1)
                assert chunk,'client exited without response'
                raw.extend(chunk)
                if chunk==b'\n':break
            value=raw.decode('utf8')
            assert all(token not in value for token in issued),'issued token printed'
            return value.strip()
        def finish(p):
            if p.poll() is None:p.terminate()
            try:stdout,stderr=p.communicate(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                p.kill();stdout,stderr=p.communicate(timeout=3)
            assert all(token not in stdout for token in issued),'issued token in remaining stdout'
            assert all(token not in stderr for token in issued),'issued token in stderr'
        p=start(ca)
        try:
            assert line(p)=='READY'
            def get(path):p.stdin.write(json.dumps({'path':path})+'\n');p.stdin.flush();return json.loads(line(p))
            visible='/api/v1/namespaces/training/configmaps/visible'
            result=get(visible);assert 'status' in result and result['status']==200 and result['body']['data']['evidence']==marker
            assert get('/api/v1/namespaces/training/secrets').get('status')==403
            assert get('/api/v1/namespaces/default/configmaps/visible').get('status')==403
            tokenfile.write_text(external);assert get(visible).get('status')==401,'external audience accidentally accepted or client cached API token'
            tokenfile.write_text(' \t'+kube+'\r\n');assert get(visible).get('status')==200
            tokenfile.write_text('invalid-token');assert get(visible).get('status')==401
            tokenfile.write_text(kube);assert get(visible).get('status')==200
            code,_=api.request('DELETE',sa+'/viewer');assert code==200
            new=api.create(sa,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ServiceAccount','metadata':{'name':'viewer'}});assert new['metadata']['uid']!=identity['metadata']['uid']
            # v1.34.1 caches successful bearer authentication for 10 seconds.
            # Establish revocation using an independent TLS client before judging learner behavior.
            context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(ca));opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=context))
            deadline=time.monotonic()+15;statuses=[]
            while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                request=urllib.request.Request(api.url+visible,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+kube})
                try:
                    with opener.open(request,timeout=3) as response:code=response.status;response.read()
                except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:code=error.code;error.read()
                statuses.append(code)
                if code==401:break
                assert code==200,'unexpected independent revocation probe status'
                time.sleep(.2)
            else:raise RuntimeError('native API revocation did not converge within fixture budget')
            print('revocation converged after '+str(len(statuses))+' independent probes; student status checked only afterwards')
            assert get(visible).get('status')==401,'old UID token remained accepted after independent revocation confirmation'
            replacement=issue(KUBE);incoming=actor/'next-token';incoming.write_text(replacement);os.replace(incoming,tokenfile)
            result=get(visible);assert 'status' in result and result['status']==200 and result['body']['data']['evidence']==marker,'client did not read rotated token file'
            assert get('/api/v1/namespaces/training/secrets').get('status')==403
        finally:
            finish(p)
        # A wrong trust root must not be treated as a successful TLS connection.
        api.openssl('req','-x509','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes','-keyout','other.key','-out','other.crt','-days','1','-subj','/CN=untrusted teaching CA')
        wrong=actor/'wrong-ca.crt';shutil.copyfile(api.root/'other.crt',wrong);p=start(wrong)
        try:
            greeting=line(p)
            if greeting=='READY':
                p.stdin.write(json.dumps({'path':visible})+'\n');p.stdin.flush();result=json.loads(line(p))
            else:result=json.loads(greeting)
            assert 'error' in result,'TLS verification bypassed'
        finally:
            try:finish(p)
            finally:proxy_guard.close()
    assert api.get(rb+'/roles/viewer')['rules']==role['rules'],'original RBAC was replaced'
print('real TokenRequest/TokenReview, audience isolation, API401/RBAC403, rotated token file and TLS trust passed; no kubelet projection/rotation controller claimed')

title: 修复租户CEL准入门禁的更新、参数错误与作用域漏洞
body:
## 操作任务
编辑 policy.json 和 binding.json，修复租户准入门禁。平台自动提供隔离的真实 Kubernetes 1.34.1 API/etcd；不需要自己打开K8s。本题没有kubelet、Deployment控制器或镜像运行，只验准入行为。
提供的 namespaced TenantLimit CRD 为 limits.training.invalid/v1，参数对象在 policy-config/tenant-limits；spec.maxReplicas 为整数，spec.registryPrefix 为非空字符串。这两个字段可能缺失，以便演练配置错误；不得修改参数CRD/资源、绕过为管理员身份或更改命名空间标签。
Policy及Binding均固定名tenant-contract。对 tenant=blue 命名空间内 apps/v1 Deployment 的 CREATE 和 UPDATE执行：副本数不大于动态参数maxReplicas（含0和相等值）；所有普通containers的镜像必须以完整registryPrefix开头，包括sidecar。平台会动态更换租户参数，不能硬编码阈值或仓库。默认缺省replicas由API默认化为1，不能因输入缺字段误拒合法对象。
当前是正式Deny阶段：Binding.validationActions仅为[Deny]；paramRef固定name/namespace且parameterNotFoundAction=Deny；Policy.failurePolicy=Fail。参数对象不存在以及参数字段缺失引起的CEL求值错误都不能放行；与明确违反策略的情况区分诊断。未带tenant=blue标签的命名空间不受本策略限制。允许等价CEL写法或命名空间选择器，不要求逐字匹配表达式。
只提交两个JSON配置文件，每个不超过32KiB，禁止重复键。保留顶层apiVersion/kind/metadata.name和给定paramKind/paramRef身份，不添加状态字段或其他资源。

## 产物
policy.json 与 binding.json，交付动态租户策略及绑定。

## 验收方法
真正安装VAP/Binding和参数CRD，使用随机仓库前缀、更新后的阈值、多容器镜像以及真实CREATE/UPDATE请求验证接受与拒绝；参数对象缺失/字段错误必须拒绝，恢复参数后再次接受。仅在隔离临时API中操作。

准入行为使用隔离租户ServiceAccount真实Bearer身份验证，原管理员与上下文不变；其仅有测试命名空间Deployment的create/get/update权限。除了dry-run还实际提交违规CREATE并核实对象未持久化。参数中的副本阈值和仓库前缀都动态变化，并分别测试缺字段与恢复。

rubric: 依据题给约束推演而非复述术语
明确关键证据、作用边界与处理顺序
提出可判定的验证及失败处置

import copy,hashlib,json,pathlib,secrets,ssl,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/incident.txt': '3aa119ea7e272882018d450ee9c0c6a288f7f99ced06b706b71f175aaf2b58c7', 'fixtures/contract.json': '3f8680d86b5310bf01a266caa59174890923f93337686d79130bcb8e6b24a8a1'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly material changed'
def pairs(items):
    result={}
    for key,value in items:assert key not in result,'duplicate JSON key';result[key]=value
    return result
def load(name,kind):
    p=ROOT/name;assert p.stat().st_size<=32768,'configuration budget'
    obj=json.loads(p.read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs)
    assert obj['apiVersion']=='admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1' and obj['kind']==kind
    assert obj['metadata']=={'name':'tenant-contract'},'only declared policy identity allowed'
    assert set(obj)=={'apiVersion','kind','metadata','spec'},'unexpected top-level fields'
    return obj
policy=load('policy.json','ValidatingAdmissionPolicy');binding=load('binding.json','ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding')
assert policy['spec'].get('paramKind')=={'apiVersion':'limits.training.invalid/v1','kind':'TenantLimit'},'use provided dynamic parameter kind'
assert policy['spec'].get('failurePolicy')=='Fail','runtime evaluation errors must fail closed'
assert binding['spec']['policyName']=='tenant-contract'
assert binding['spec']['paramRef']=={'name':'tenant-limits','namespace':'policy-config','parameterNotFoundAction':'Deny'},'missing parameters must deny'
assert binding['spec']['validationActions']==['Deny'],'enforcing phase, not warn-only'
with ControlPlane() as api:
    ns='/api/v1/namespaces'
    for name,labels in [('selected',{'tenant':'blue'}),('selected-two',{'tenant':'blue'}),('red-tenant',{'tenant':'red'}),('untouched',{}),('policy-config',{})]:api.create(ns,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name,'labels':labels}})
    schema={'type':'object','properties':{'spec':{'type':'object','properties':{'maxReplicas':{'type':'integer','minimum':0},'registryPrefix':{'type':'string','minLength':1}}}}}
    crd={'apiVersion':'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1','kind':'CustomResourceDefinition','metadata':{'name':'tenantlimits.limits.training.invalid'},'spec':{'group':'limits.training.invalid','scope':'Namespaced','names':{'plural':'tenantlimits','singular':'tenantlimit','kind':'TenantLimit'},'versions':[{'name':'v1','served':True,'storage':True,'schema':{'openAPIV3Schema':schema}}]}}

    params='/apis/limits.training.invalid/v1/namespaces/policy-config/tenantlimits'

    prefix='registry.example.invalid/team-'+secrets.token_hex(3)+'/'

    api.create('/api/v1/namespaces/selected/serviceaccounts',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ServiceAccount','metadata':{'name':'tenant-actor'}})
    for name in ('selected','selected-two','red-tenant','untouched'):
        rb='/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+name
        api.create(rb+'/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':'tenant-deployer'},'rules':[{'apiGroups':['apps'],'resources':['deployments'],'verbs':['create','get','update']}]})
        api.create(rb+'/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':'tenant-deployer'},'subjects':[{'kind':'ServiceAccount','name':'tenant-actor','namespace':'selected'}],'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':'tenant-deployer'}})
    token=api.create('/api/v1/namespaces/selected/serviceaccounts/tenant-actor/token',{'apiVersion':'authentication.k8s.io/v1','kind':'TokenRequest','spec':{'audiences':[api.url],'expirationSeconds':600}})['status']['token']
    # CA-only context: no administrator client certificate is carried with the bearer token.
    api.contexts['tenant-token']=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(api.root/'ca.crt'))
    actor_headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token}
    code,identity=api.request('POST','/apis/authentication.k8s.io/v1/selfsubjectreviews',{'apiVersion':'authentication.k8s.io/v1','kind':'SelfSubjectReview'},user='tenant-token',headers=actor_headers)
    assert code==201 and identity['status']['userInfo']['username']=='system:serviceaccount:selected:tenant-actor','must test the isolated tenant identity'
    deadline=time.monotonic()+10
    for name in ('selected','selected-two','red-tenant','untouched'):
        while True:
            code,result=api.request('GET','/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/'+name+'/deployments/rbac-readiness',user='tenant-token',headers=actor_headers)
            if code==404:break
            assert code==403 and time.monotonic()<deadline,'tenant RBAC did not become effective'
            time.sleep(.15)
    serial=0
    def deployment(replicas=1,images=None):
        global serial
        serial+=1;label='app-'+str(serial)
        return {'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'Deployment','metadata':{'name':label},'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':label}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':label}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'container-'+str(i),'image':image} for i,image in enumerate(images or [prefix+'app:v1'])]}}}}
    def request(method,path,obj):
        code,result=api.request(method,path,obj,user='tenant-token',headers=actor_headers)
        # Native CEL default reason is Invalid (422); explicit Forbidden is also legitimate.
        # Do not confuse a schema-validation 422 with this policy's admission rejection.
        if code in (403,422) and isinstance(result,dict) and "ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'tenant-contract'" in result.get('message','') and 'denied request' in result.get('message',''):
            code=403
        return code,result
    def create(obj,namespace='selected',dry=True):return request('POST','/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/'+namespace+'/deployments'+('?dryRun=All' if dry else ''),obj)
    def expect(obj,status,namespace='selected'):
        code,result=create(obj,namespace);assert code==status,(status,code,result)
        if status==403:assert result.get('reason') in ('Forbidden','Invalid') and "ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'tenant-contract'" in result.get('message',''),'must be this policy admission denial'
        return result
    def wait_for(obj,status,why):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+10
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            code,result=create(obj)
            if code==status:return
            assert code in (201,403),(why,code,result)
            time.sleep(.15)
        raise AssertionError('policy propagation/behavior failed: '+why)
    wait_for(deployment(3),403,'initial bound enforcement')
    for replicas in (0,1,2):expect(deployment(replicas),201)
    omitted=deployment(1);omitted['spec'].pop('replicas');assert expect(omitted,201)['spec']['replicas']==1
    expect(deployment(3),403)
    expect(deployment(1,[prefix+'api:v1','foreign.example.invalid/sidecar:v1']),403)
    expect(deployment(1,[prefix.rstrip('/')+'-fake/app:v1']),403)
    expect(deployment(2,[prefix+'api:v1',prefix+'sidecar:v1']),201)
    expect(deployment(20,['foreign.example.invalid/app:v1']),201,'untouched')
    expect(deployment(20,['foreign.example.invalid/app:v1']),201,'red-tenant')
    expect(deployment(2),201,'selected-two');expect(deployment(3),403,'selected-two')
    for bad in (deployment(3),deployment(1,[prefix+'api:v1','foreign.example.invalid/sidecar:v1'])):
        code,result=create(bad,dry=False)
        assert code==403 and "ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'tenant-contract'" in result.get('message','') and "binding 'tenant-contract'" in result.get('message',''),'live CREATE must be rejected by this binding'
        status,result=api.request('GET','/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/selected/deployments/'+bad['metadata']['name']);assert status==404,'rejected workload persisted'

    created=api.create('/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/selected/deployments',deployment(1))
    path='/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/selected/deployments/'+created['metadata']['name']
    changed=copy.deepcopy(created);changed['spec']['replicas']=3
    code,result=request('PUT',path,changed);assert code==403,(code,result)
    unchanged=api.get(path);assert unchanged['spec']['replicas']==1,'rejected update persisted'
    changed=copy.deepcopy(unchanged);changed['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'].append({'name':'bad-sidecar','image':'foreign.example.invalid/x:v1'})
    code,result=request('PUT',path,changed);assert code==403,(code,result)
    changed=api.get(path);changed['spec']['replicas']=2;code,result=request('PUT',path,changed);assert code==200,(code,result)
    # Parameter values vary after policy installation, preventing a hardcoded threshold.
    current=api.get(params+'/tenant-limits');current['spec']['maxReplicas']=4
    code,result=api.request('PUT',params+'/tenant-limits',current);assert code==200,(code,result)
    wait_for(deployment(4),201,'new parameter threshold')
    expect(deployment(4),201);expect(deployment(5),403)
    old_prefix=prefix;prefix='registry.example.invalid/changed-'+secrets.token_hex(3)+'/'
    current=api.get(params+'/tenant-limits');current['spec']['registryPrefix']=prefix
    code,result=api.request('PUT',params+'/tenant-limits',current);assert code==200,(code,result)
    wait_for(deployment(1),201,'new registry prefix')
    expect(deployment(1,[old_prefix+'app:v1']),403);expect(deployment(1,[prefix+'app:v1',prefix+'sidecar:v1']),201)
    current=api.get(params+'/tenant-limits');current['spec'].pop('registryPrefix')
    code,result=api.request('PUT',params+'/tenant-limits',current);assert code==200,(code,result)
    wait_for(deployment(1),403,'missing registryPrefix fail closed')
    expect(deployment(1),403)
    current=api.get(params+'/tenant-limits');current['spec']['registryPrefix']=prefix
    code,result=api.request('PUT',params+'/tenant-limits',current);assert code==200,(code,result)
    wait_for(deployment(1),201,'registryPrefix recovery')

    # Valid CR shape with omitted maxReplicas produces CEL missing-field evaluation.
    current=api.get(params+'/tenant-limits');current['spec'].pop('maxReplicas')
    code,result=api.request('PUT',params+'/tenant-limits',current);assert code==200,(code,result)
    wait_for(deployment(1),403,'missing field/evaluation error fail closed')
    expect(deployment(1),403);expect(deployment(1),201,'untouched')
    # Missing parameter object has a separate binding policy, not failurePolicy alone.
    code,result=api.request('DELETE',params+'/tenant-limits');assert code==200,(code,result)
    wait_for(deployment(1),403,'missing parameter object')
    expect(deployment(1),403)
    api.create(params,parameter({'maxReplicas':2,'registryPrefix':prefix}))
    wait_for(deployment(2),201,'parameter recovery')
    expect(deployment(2),201);expect(deployment(3),403)
    assert api.get(ns+'/untouched')['metadata'].get('labels',{}).get('tenant') is None,'unrelated namespace changed'
print('native CEL CREATE/UPDATE, dynamic parameters, missing/error fail-closed and namespace boundary passed; no workload controller executed')

title: 项目挑战：交付租户预算、默认资源与sidecar的真实准入契约
body:
## 操作任务
交付 quota.json 和 limits.json，建立完整租户准入契约。平台自动提供临时真实Kubernetes API/etcd和多个独立命名空间；无需自己搭集群。只编辑两个JSON，metadata只包含固定name，不能增加namespace/status/scopes或其他资源，每文件不超过32KiB且无重复键。
租户总量：requests.cpu=1核、requests.memory=512Mi、limits.cpu=2核、limits.memory=1Gi，最多3个非终止Pod。ResourceQuota名tenant-budget，不可只限requests而遗漏limits/内存/Pod数。允许语义相同的Kubernetes数量单位。
LimitRange名tenant-container-contract，仅一个Container规则：未给资源时defaultRequest为100m/64Mi，default limits为300m/128Mi；每容器min为50m/32Mi，max为1核/512Mi；CPU和内存limit/request比例都最多4。显式请求必须保留；只写limits时核心API先将requests默认成limits，不应误以为此时使用defaultRequest。
必须对带普通sidecar的完整Pod计量，不能逐容器都合法就放过总预算超额。正式创建会更新quota used，dry-run不占额度；拒绝的Pod也不能留下用量变化。相等边界合法。平台逐项测试缺请求/缺限制、单容器上下限/比例、每种总量超额和第4个Pod。
环境不含kubelet、调度器或quota reconciliation控制器。夹具在每个新命名空间仅显式初始化quota.status.hard/used一次，之后所有用量变化由真正admission执行，不使用Python计算结果冒充API。不测试删除后的配额回补、控制器自动重新计算、真实资源消耗或HPA。对象已被API接受不代表容器已运行。保留原题关于容量规划、默认值与上线回退的知识说明。

## 产物
quota.json与limits.json，完整租户资源预算及默认/边界策略。

## 验收方法
真实API提交不同Pod模板，读取默认后的资源以及quota.status.used；分别隔离测试CPU/内存请求与限制总量、数量、sidecar、单容器最小最大及比例，检查dry-run和拒绝不占用量。
source: OpsForge 原创高级与项目题；依据官方机制编审
rubric: 依据题给约束推演而非复述术语
明确关键证据、作用边界与处理顺序
提出可判定的验证及失败处置

import copy,hashlib,json,pathlib,secrets,sys,time
from decimal import Decimal
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/budget.json': '7c3f60839954ac72370660fdc8b8f9089d24c06ed4262aeda8dd33f53ab7fba1', 'fixtures/incident.txt': '4b15de81df803ae6a84660bd5fa0d39ae034a14aa24c983871c071c70eedf844'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly material changed'
def pairs(items):
    d={}
    for k,v in items:assert k not in d,'duplicate JSON key';d[k]=v
    return d
def load(name,kind,identity):
    p=ROOT/name;assert p.stat().st_size<=32768
    o=json.loads(p.read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs)
    assert o['apiVersion']=='v1' and o['kind']==kind and o['metadata']=={'name':identity}
    assert set(o)=={'apiVersion','kind','metadata','spec'},'only declared configuration'
    return o
quota=load('quota.json','ResourceQuota','tenant-budget');limit=load('limits.json','LimitRange','tenant-container-contract')
assert set(quota['spec'])=={'hard'} and set(quota['spec']['hard'])=={'requests.cpu','requests.memory','limits.cpu','limits.memory','pods'},'all five unscoped dimensions required'
assert len(limit['spec']['limits'])==1 and limit['spec']['limits'][0]['type']=='Container','one predictable container contract'
def quantity(v):
    assert isinstance(v,str),'quantities must be strings'
    units={'Ki':1024,'Mi':1024**2,'Gi':1024**3,'Ti':1024**4,'Pi':1024**5,'Ei':1024**6,'n':Decimal('1e-9'),'u':Decimal('1e-6'),'m':Decimal('.001'),'k':1000,'K':1000,'M':10**6,'G':10**9,'T':10**12,'P':10**15,'E':10**18}
    for suffix,scale in units.items():
        if v.endswith(suffix):return Decimal(v[:-len(suffix)])*scale
    return Decimal(v)
budget={'requests.cpu':Decimal(1),'requests.memory':Decimal(512*1024**2),'limits.cpu':Decimal(2),'limits.memory':Decimal(1024**3),'pods':Decimal(3)}
assert {k:quantity(v) for k,v in quota['spec']['hard'].items()}==budget,'tenant budget cannot be relaxed'
expected={'defaultRequest':{'cpu':Decimal('.1'),'memory':Decimal(64*1024**2)},'default':{'cpu':Decimal('.3'),'memory':Decimal(128*1024**2)},'min':{'cpu':Decimal('.05'),'memory':Decimal(32*1024**2)},'max':{'cpu':Decimal(1),'memory':Decimal(512*1024**2)},'maxLimitRequestRatio':{'cpu':Decimal(4),'memory':Decimal(4)}}
assert set(limit['spec'])=={'limits'},'unexpected LimitRange spec fields'
rule=limit['spec']['limits'][0]
assert set(rule)=={'type',*expected},'all five resource mappings required'
for field,required in expected.items():
    actual=rule[field];assert isinstance(actual,dict) and set(actual)=={'cpu','memory'},'each resource mapping needs exactly cpu and memory'
    assert {k:quantity(v) for k,v in actual.items()}==required,'fixed container contract changed: '+field

with ControlPlane() as api:
    index=0
    def namespace():
        global index
        index+=1;name='quota-case-'+str(index)
        api.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})
        api.create('/api/v1/namespaces/'+name+'/serviceaccounts',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ServiceAccount','metadata':{'name':'default'}})
        base='/api/v1/namespaces/'+name
        api.create(base+'/limitranges',limit)
        obj=api.create(base+'/resourcequotas',quota)
        # This explicit harness seed replaces only the absent initial quota-controller sync.
        # Real admission owns all subsequent usage increments. No reset after Pod creation.
        obj['status']={'hard':obj['spec']['hard'],'used':{k:'0' for k in budget}}
        code,result=api.request('PUT',base+'/resourcequotas/tenant-budget/status',obj);assert code==200,(code,result)
        return base
    def resources(rc='100m',rm='64Mi',lc='300m',lm='128Mi'):return {'requests':{'cpu':rc,'memory':rm},'limits':{'cpu':lc,'memory':lm}}
    counter=0
    def pod(containers):
        global counter
        counter+=1
        return {'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':'sample-'+str(counter)},'spec':{'automountServiceAccountToken':False,'restartPolicy':'Never','containers':[{'name':'c'+str(i),'image':'example.invalid/training:no-run',**({'resources':r} if r is not None else {})} for i,r in enumerate(containers)]}}
    def expect(base,containers,code=201,dry=False):
        status,obj=api.request('POST',base+'/pods'+('?dryRun=All' if dry else ''),pod(containers));assert status==code,(code,status,obj)
        if code==403:assert obj.get('reason')=='Forbidden'
        return obj
    def usage(base):return {k:quantity(v) for k,v in api.get(base+'/resourcequotas/tenant-budget')['status']['used'].items()}
    # Wait only for cache propagation: a dry-run default Pod must expose the new limits.
    base=namespace();deadline=time.monotonic()+10
    while True:
        o=expect(base,[None],dry=True);r=o['spec']['containers'][0]['resources']
        if r.get('requests',{}).get('cpu')=='100m':break
        assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'LimitRange defaults not active';time.sleep(.15)
    r=expect(base,[None])['spec']['containers'][0]['resources']
    assert {k:quantity(v) for k,v in r['requests'].items()}=={'cpu':Decimal('.1'),'memory':Decimal(64*1024**2)}
    assert {k:quantity(v) for k,v in r['limits'].items()}=={'cpu':Decimal('.3'),'memory':Decimal(128*1024**2)}
    assert usage(base)=={'requests.cpu':Decimal('.1'),'requests.memory':Decimal(64*1024**2),'limits.cpu':Decimal('.3'),'limits.memory':Decimal(128*1024**2),'pods':Decimal(1)},'native admission must account final defaults'
    # Dry-run cannot consume quota or persist a workload.
    before=usage(base);expect(base,[resources()],dry=True);assert usage(base)==before
    # Missing requests with explicit limits use core API defaults (requests=limits), not defaultRequest.
    obj=expect(namespace(),[{'limits':{'cpu':'200m','memory':'96Mi'}}]);rr=obj['spec']['containers'][0]['resources']
    assert {k:quantity(v) for k,v in rr['requests'].items()}=={'cpu':Decimal('.2'),'memory':Decimal(96*1024**2)}
    # Missing limits receive LimitRange defaults; provided requests remain intact.
    obj=expect(namespace(),[{'requests':{'cpu':'150m','memory':'64Mi'}}]);rr=obj['spec']['containers'][0]['resources']
    assert quantity(rr['requests']['cpu'])==Decimal('.15') and quantity(rr['limits']['cpu'])==Decimal('.3')
    base=namespace();good=expect(base,[resources('200m','128Mi','500m','256Mi'),resources('100m','64Mi','200m','128Mi')])
    used=usage(base);assert used=={'requests.cpu':Decimal('.3'),'requests.memory':Decimal(192*1024**2),'limits.cpu':Decimal('.7'),'limits.memory':Decimal(384*1024**2),'pods':Decimal(1)},'ordinary sidecar counted in same Pod budget'
    # Each dimension is isolated from unrelated limits to expose missing dimensions.
    tests=[
      [resources('600m','64Mi','800m','128Mi')]*2,
      [resources('100m','384Mi','300m','512Mi')]*2,
      [resources('200m','64Mi','800m','128Mi')]*3,
      [resources('100m','128Mi','300m','400Mi')]*3,
    ]
    for containers in tests:
        base=namespace();before=usage(base);expect(base,containers,403);assert usage(base)==before,'rejected Pod consumed quota'
    base=namespace()
    for _ in range(3):expect(base,[None])
    before=usage(base);expect(base,[None],403);assert usage(base)==before and before['pods']==3
    # Single-container minima/maxima/ratios must be enforced independently of total quota.
    for r in [resources('40m','64Mi','100m','128Mi'),resources('100m','16Mi','300m','64Mi'),resources('300m','64Mi','1100m','128Mi'),resources('100m','256Mi','300m','600Mi'),resources('100m','64Mi','450m','128Mi'),resources('100m','64Mi','300m','300Mi')]:
        base=namespace();expect(base,[r],403)
    # Boundary values and valid ratios are legal, not blanket-denied.
    expect(namespace(),[resources('50m','32Mi','200m','128Mi')])
    expect(namespace(),[resources('250m','128Mi','1','512Mi')])
print('native LimitRange defaults/ranges/ratios and ResourceQuota admission/usage/sidecar boundaries passed; no quota-controller deletion reclamation or scheduling claimed')

title: 实操修复并行测试分片遗漏与最后退出码误放行
source: 独立编审：流水线执行与交付治理
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
rubric: 解释本题机制
列出对应失败边界与验证

exercise.environment: 平台本机隔离Python子进程；最多4个短任务；不启动Jenkins
exercise.operation:
补齐并行测试门禁函数run_shards(shards, report_dir, timeout)，文件parallel_gate.py。平台提供最多4个真实短子进程，shards为非空列表，每项id是唯一安全文件名，argv为完整参数数组；命令可信、可启动且不会派生后代，输出不超过4KiB。report_dir起始不存在；timeout是每个分片从启动起计的正秒数。
先启动所有分片，再收集全部结果；分片在共同文件屏障会合，不能用依次启动/等完一个再启动另一个冒充并行，也不以固定sleep或运行耗时猜是否并行。任一失败不应遗漏其他分片。每个分片超时需终止并回收该子进程，仍收集其他分片。仅处理本次启动的子进程。
返回{'passed':布尔值,'results':[{'id':原id,'status':'passed'/'failed'/'timeout','exit_code':实际整数退出码}]}，results顺序任意但每项恰好一次。正常退出0为passed，非0为failed，发生超时为timeout；总passed当且仅当所有分片passed。保存每项原始stdout/stderr字节到report_dir/<id>.stdout与<id>.stderr，包含失败与超时前已输出内容；不经过shell拼接，不丢失带空格或特殊字符的参数。此题是本机进程级CI门禁，不宣称启动了Jenkins或部署服务。
超时时使用强制kill并wait回收（Linux为SIGKILL，真实returncode=-9），不能编造退出码或把超时当普通失败。后续分片的deadline仍由各自启动时间决定，等待前一项不能重新获得完整timeout。报告须逐字节保存，可能含NUL、非UTF-8字节、CRLF及末尾空格/换行，不得解码清洗。

title: 实操隔离发布成功状态与通知失败
answer:
通常不应，通知是部署后的独立副作用，应记录失败并重试告知。先确认业务部署状态和版本证据，再决定是否需要人为升级；不要让邮件超时把成功环境误标为未部署。

```python
import http.client,json,pathlib,urllib.parse

def notify_release(release_file, url, result_file, timeout=.3):
    release=json.loads(pathlib.Path(release_file).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    if not isinstance(release,dict) or set(release)!={'status','version'} or release['status']!='deployed' or not isinstance(release['version'],str) or not release['version']:raise ValueError('no successful release evidence')
    parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    conn=http.client.HTTPConnection(parsed.hostname,parsed.port,timeout=timeout)
    sent=False
    try:
        body=json.dumps({'status':'deployed','version':release['version']},ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf8')
        conn.request('POST',(parsed.path or '/')+('?' + parsed.query if parsed.query else ''),body=body,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();response.read();sent=200<=response.status<300
    except (OSError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
    finally:conn.close()
    result={'deployment':'deployed','version':release['version'],'notification':'sent' if sent else 'failed'}
    pathlib.Path(result_file).write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
    return result
```
部署状态与通知送达是两个事实。只写独立通知结果，让后续调度决定重试；不能因邮件/消息失败把真实成功发布改成失败。

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source_dir=$1
output=$2
cd "$source_dir"
export GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOENV=off CGO_ENABLED=0 GOMAXPROCS=2
go build -p=1 -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags "-X main.version=$APP_VERSION -X main.buildEpoch=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" -o "$output" .
```

ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ci reproducible ') as d:
    root=pathlib.Path(d);cache=root/'build cache';token=secrets.token_hex(3);v='v2.'+str(secrets.randbelow(50)+10)+'.'+str(secrets.randbelow(50)+10);epoch=str(1700000000+secrets.randbelow(99999))
    sources={p.name:p.read_bytes() for p in (ROOT/'fixtures/source').iterdir()};before={k:hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for k,v in sources.items()}
    assert before=={'go.mod': 'a533f49846c23bc2a92b8c45519ff5f9f0e03d01161aabe60e1bb335bd40841b', 'main.go': 'a104ea89b3a73b56e11724814d6fd0aabd00832e102d0709896eb91e55be6892'},'readonly Go fixture changed'
    def build(folder,tz,version,stamp,mtime):
        src=root/folder;src.mkdir();out=root/(folder+' program')
        for name,data in sources.items():
            p=src/name;p.write_bytes(data);os.utime(p,(mtime,mtime))
        env={**os.environ,'GOTOOLCHAIN':'local','GOPROXY':'off','GOENV':'off','CGO_ENABLED':'0','GOMAXPROCS':'2','GOCACHE':str(cache),'APP_VERSION':version,'SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH':stamp,'TZ':tz}
        r=subprocess.run(['bash',str(ROOT/'build.sh'),str(src),str(out)],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65)
        assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr[-1600:]
        assert {p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in src.iterdir()}==before,'build modified readonly source'
        info=subprocess.run(['go','version','-m',str(out)],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
        fields=[line.strip().split() for line in info.stdout.splitlines()]
        assert info.returncode==0 and ['path','example.invalid/repro'] in fields and ['mod','example.invalid/repro','(devel)'] in fields,'artifact must contain actual Go module build information, not a script'
        r=subprocess.run([str(out)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
        actual=json.loads(r.stdout);assert actual=={'version':version,'epoch':stamp,'source':'example.invalid/repro/main.go'},'runtime version/epoch or trimpath missing'
        return out.read_bytes()
    first=build('checkout A '+token,'UTC',v,epoch,1500000000)
    second=build('checkout B '+token,'Pacific/Honolulu',v,epoch,1800000000)
    assert first==second,'same fixed build inputs must produce byte-identical executable across paths/mtime/TZ'
    third=build('release C '+token,'UTC',v+'-rc1',str(int(epoch)+9),1600000000)
    assert first!=third,'explicit changed version/epoch must change executable'
    assert {p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (ROOT/'fixtures/source').iterdir()}==before
print('actual Go compiler and executable: fixed-toolchain reproducibility, path removal, explicit version/epoch propagation, source preservation; no network')

source: 独立编审：流水线执行与交付治理
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,pathlib,secrets,tempfile
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd();spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission',ROOT/'shard.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='real test discovery ') as d:
    root=pathlib.Path(d);suite=root/'suite';suite.mkdir();(suite/'nested').mkdir();(suite/'nested/__init__.py').write_text('');log=root/'actual-events.jsonl';report=root/'report.json';suffix=secrets.token_hex(4);expected=[]
    for prefix,num in [('test_a',3),('test_b',2),('nested/test_c',4)]:
        module=prefix+suffix;code='import json,os,unittest\nfrom pathlib import Path\nclass Checks(unittest.TestCase):\n'
        for i in range(num):
            name='test_case_'+str(i);ident=module.replace('/','.')+'.Checks.'+name;expected.append(ident)
            code+='    def '+name+'(self):\n        with Path(os.environ["OPSF_EVENTS"]).open("a",encoding="utf8") as f:f.write(json.dumps(self.id())+"\\n")\n        self.assertNotEqual(self.id(),os.environ.get("OPSF_FAIL_ID",""))\n'
        (suite/(module+'.py')).write_text(code,encoding='utf8')
    expected.sort();before={str(p.relative_to(suite)):p.read_bytes() for p in suite.rglob('*') if p.is_file()};os.environ['OPSF_EVENTS']=str(log)
    def bucket(count,index):return [x for x in expected if int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(x.encode()).digest(),'big')%count==index]
    for count in [1,2,5,13]:
        observed=[]
        # Reverse order means discovery/selection must not depend on which shard ran first.
        for index in reversed(range(count)):
            log.write_text('');os.environ.pop('OPSF_FAIL_ID',None);wanted=bucket(count,index);r=m.run_shard(str(suite),count,index,str(report))
            actual=[json.loads(line) for line in log.read_text().splitlines()]
            assert actual==wanted,'actual unittest execution must match stable selected IDs exactly once'
            assert r=={'selected':wanted,'successful':True} and json.loads(report.read_text())==r
            observed+=actual
        assert sorted(observed)==expected and len(observed)==len(set(observed)),'changed shard count lost or duplicated test coverage'
    fail=expected[0];count=1;index=0;log.write_text('');os.environ['OPSF_FAIL_ID']=fail
    r=m.run_shard(str(suite),count,index,str(report));assert r=={'selected':bucket(count,index),'successful':False} and json.loads(report.read_text())==r
    assert [json.loads(line) for line in log.read_text().splitlines()]==bucket(count,index),'one failed test must not discard other selected cases'
    os.environ.pop('OPSF_FAIL_ID',None)
    for count,index in [(0,0),(2,2),(2,-1),(True,0),(2,False)]:
        prior=report.read_bytes();events=log.read_bytes()
        try:m.run_shard(str(suite),count,index,str(report))
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('invalid shard accepted')
        assert report.read_bytes()==prior and log.read_bytes()==events
    assert {str(p.relative_to(suite)):p.read_bytes() for p in suite.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}==before,'readonly test source mutated'
print('real unittest discovery and test execution, deterministic ID partition, exact-once union across changing counts, empty shards and actual failure propagation')

exercise.operation:
修复shard.py的run_shard(test_root, count, index, report)，使调整分片数后仍运行完整测试集。使用真实unittest发现test_root内及Python包子目录中的test_*.py测试，按完整test.id()划分；不要只扫描顶层、仅返回推测的测试名称或改写测试代码。
分片规则固定为int.from_bytes(SHA256(test.id().encode("utf8")).digest(),"big") % count == index。每片按test.id排序实际执行自己选中的TestCase；空片合法，返回成功。返回并写JSON {"selected":[本片ID按升序],"successful":实际unittest结果是否成功}。失败测试不应让同片剩余测试被遗漏。count/index必须是非bool整数，count>=1且0<=index<count；非法参数在执行任何测试/改写报告前抛ValueError。
测试源只读，平台提供私有目录、stdlib unittest和可观测测试事件。不同分片数及执行顺序下，每片实际事件必须与所选ID一致，总并集等于发现集合且无重复；本题不要求并行启动，不重做JUnit XML解析，也不部署服务。

修复shard.py的run_shard(test_root, count, index, report)，使调整分片数后仍运行完整测试集。使用真实unittest发现test_root内及Python包子目录中的test_*.py测试，按完整test.id()划分；不要只扫描顶层、仅返回推测的测试名称或改写测试代码。
分片规则固定为int.from_bytes(SHA256(test.id().encode("utf8")).digest(),"big") % count == index。每片按test.id排序实际执行自己选中的TestCase；空片合法，返回成功。返回并写JSON {"selected":[本片ID按升序],"successful":实际unittest结果是否成功}。失败测试不应让同片剩余测试被遗漏。count/index必须是非bool整数，count>=1且0<=index<count；非法参数在执行任何测试/改写报告前抛ValueError。
测试源只读，平台提供私有目录、stdlib unittest和可观测测试事件。不同分片数及执行顺序下，每片实际事件必须与所选ID一致，总并集等于发现集合且无重复；本题不要求并行启动，不重做JUnit XML解析，也不部署服务。

## 产物
shard.py与各分片执行报告。

## 验收方法
真实unittest执行事件与稳定ID分配比较，不能以手写报告替代测试执行。

import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,secrets,tempfile,warnings,zipfile
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd();spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission',ROOT/'audit_plugins.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hpi metadata audit ') as d:
    root=pathlib.Path(d);output=root/'report.json';suffix=secrets.token_hex(3);a='consumer-'+suffix;b='base-'+suffix;c='extra-'+suffix;missing='absent-'+suffix
    def archive(name,release='1.0',minimum='2.10',dependencies='',fold=False,extra='',duplicate=False):
        p=root/(name+'-'+secrets.token_hex(2)+'.hpi');dep=dependencies
        if fold and dep:
            cut=len(dep)//2;dep=dep[:cut]+'\r\n '+dep[cut:]
        text='Manifest-Version: 1.0\r\nShort-Name: '+name+'\r\nPlugin-Version: '+release+'\r\nJenkins-Version: '+minimum+'\r\n'+('Plugin-Dependencies: '+dep+'\r\n' if dep else '')+extra+'\r\nName: ignored-entry\r\nShort-Name: wrong-section\r\n'
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter('ignore',UserWarning)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(p,'w') as z:
                z.writestr('META-INF/MANIFEST.MF',text);z.writestr('WEB-INF/classes/fixture.txt','not executed')
                if duplicate:z.writestr('META-INF/MANIFEST.MF',text)
        return p
    def run(paths,core,problems):
        before={p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths};wanted={'compatible':not problems,'problems':sorted(problems,key=lambda p:(p['plugin'],p['kind'],p['target']))};actual=m.audit([str(p) for p in paths],core,str(output));assert actual==wanted and json.loads(output.read_text())==wanted,'actual HPI main manifest audit mismatch';assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in before.items())
    # Fold inside dependency token; optional absence permitted, installed optional low version blocks.
    consumer=archive(a,dependencies=b+':1.10,'+c+':2.10;resolution:=optional',fold=True);base=archive(b,'1.10.0');optional=archive(c,'2.9')
    run([base,consumer],'2.10',[])
    run([optional,consumer,base],'2.10',[{'plugin':a,'kind':'version','target':c,'required':'2.10','actual':'2.9'}])
    newoptional=archive(c,'2.10.0');run([consumer,newoptional,base],'2.10.0',[])
    lowbase=archive(b,'1.9');run([consumer,lowbase],'2.10',[{'plugin':a,'kind':'version','target':b,'required':'1.10','actual':'1.9'}])
    absent=archive(a,dependencies=missing+':1.0');run([absent],'2.9',[{'plugin':a,'kind':'core','target':'jenkins','required':'2.10','actual':'2.9'},{'plugin':a,'kind':'missing','target':missing,'required':'1.0','actual':None}])
    # New random explicit versions make fixed-version assumptions ineffective.
    minor=secrets.randbelow(200)+20;dynamic=archive(a,minimum='2.'+str(minor));run([dynamic],'2.'+str(minor),[]);run([dynamic],'2.'+str(minor-1),[{'plugin':a,'kind':'core','target':'jenkins','required':'2.'+str(minor),'actual':'2.'+str(minor-1)}])
    bad_cases=[[base,archive(b,'1.11')],[archive(a,extra='Short-Name: duplicate\r\n')],[archive(a,duplicate=True)],[archive(a,release='1.2-rc1')],[archive(a,dependencies=b+':1.0,'+b+':1.2')],[archive(a,dependencies=b+':1.0;resolution:=unknown')]]
    def raw_archive(text, member='META-INF/MANIFEST.MF'):
        p=root/('raw-'+secrets.token_hex(3)+'.hpi')
        with zipfile.ZipFile(p,'w') as z:z.writestr(member,text)
        return p
    good='Manifest-Version: 1.0\r\nShort-Name: '+a+'\r\nPlugin-Version: 1.0\r\nJenkins-Version: 2.10\r\n\r\n'
    run([raw_archive(good.replace('Short-Name','sHoRt-NaMe').replace('Jenkins-Version','jenkins-version'))],'2.10',[])
    bad_cases.extend([[raw_archive(good,member='OTHER.MF')],[raw_archive(' orphan\r\n'+good)],[raw_archive(good.replace('Jenkins-Version: 2.10\r\n',''))],[raw_archive(good.replace('Short-Name: '+a,'Short-Name: '+a+'\r\nshort-name: duplicate'))],[raw_archive(good+'x'*65537)]])
    for core in ['2.10-rc1','2..10','2.10.0.0.1',True]:
        previous=output.read_bytes()
        try:m.audit([str(base)],core,str(output))
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('unsupported core version accepted')
        assert output.read_bytes()==previous
    for paths in bad_cases:
        previous=output.read_bytes();snap={p:p.read_bytes() for p in paths}
        try:m.audit([str(p) for p in paths],'2.10',str(output))
        except (ValueError,zipfile.BadZipFile):pass
        else:raise AssertionError('invalid metadata accepted')
        assert output.read_bytes()==previous and all(p.read_bytes()==v for p,v in snap.items())
print('real HPI ZIP main-section manifest audit: continuations, numeric core/plugin bounds, missing versus installed optional dependencies; no Jenkins runtime claim')

exercise.environment: 平台私有真实HPI ZIP素材；Python标准库离线读取，不执行插件
exercise.operation:
补齐audit_plugins.py的audit(archives, core, output)，读取给定本地.hpi ZIP中的META-INF/MANIFEST.MF主区段，离线预检候选插件集能否满足声明的核心版本及插件依赖下限。仅读取归档，不解压/执行类、不启动Jenkins、不访问网络；archives是本次完整候选安装集，不能读取宿主插件目录。
识别Short-Name、Plugin-Version、Jenkins-Version及可选Plugin-Dependencies。主区段遇空行结束，后续条目区段忽略；头名大小写不敏感，以单空格开头的物理行按JAR规则续接前一个值（去掉该一个空格，不插额外空格）。重复主头、孤立续行、缺/重复MANIFEST、主清单超过65536字节、重复插件名或重复依赖名、畸形依赖要抛ValueError，不能改写旧报告。插件名限定[a-z][a-z0-9-]*。
教学输入版本只支持1至4段、每段1至6位十进制整数；逐段数值比较，缺段补0（1.10高于1.9，1.10等于1.10.0）。其他版本格式一律ValueError；本题不实现完整Jenkins VersionNumber对增量/hash/rc版本的规则。依赖格式name:version或name:version;resolution:=optional，多项逗号分隔。必需依赖缺失报missing；可选依赖未安装可放过，但已安装且低于下限也报version；核心低于Jenkins-Version报core。
返回并写JSON {"compatible":是否无问题,"problems":[{"plugin":依赖方名,"kind":"core|missing|version","target":"jenkins或依赖名","required":原始最低版本串,"actual":实际版本串或null}]}，problems按(plugin,kind,target)升序。必须报告全部已知不兼容，正常和异常都不修改归档。只有输入格式异常抛错，版本不兼容是报告内容。
这是真实HPI元数据的有限离线预检，不等于插件能启动：Java兼容、类加载、隐式拆分依赖、数据迁移及恢复副本流水线仍需实际Jenkins环境验证，不能据此宣称升级成功。
deliverables: 候选安装集兼容性问题JSON

exercise.environment: 平台私有本地Git仓库，无远程，无默认身份变更
exercise.operation:
补齐impact.py的select_tests(repo, base, head, modules)。从真实本地Git仓库中只读比较两个完整小写40位commit OID，返回要运行测试的模块名升序列表；拒绝浮动分支/短OID/非commit对象。差异来自已提交对象，不读当前工作区脏文件、不切分支、不写Git配置。

title: 实操阻止合并队列沿用PR绿色检查
body:
## 操作任务
补齐merge_gate.py的eligible(repo, branch_ref, base, pr, candidate, required, checks)，在只读本地Git仓库判断候选是否具有合并资格，返回严格bool。branch_ref必须是合法refs/heads/完整引用；base/pr/candidate必须完整小写40位commit OID，不能接受标签/分支名、短OID、tree或不存在对象。真实目标引用仍须等于base；candidate必须是且仅是两父merge提交，顺序为base、pr。不得改变HEAD、引用、工作区或默认Git身份配置。
required是非空且无重复的非空检查名列表。checks是可信CI采集层提供的检查记录列表，每条严格包含sha/name/run_id/status/conclusion；sha完整小写40hex，name非空字符串，run_id正整数且不能bool；status为queued/in_progress/completed，conclusion为null/success/failure/cancelled/skipped。畸形输入返回False。仅candidate上的每个required检查参与门禁；同名取最大run_id，最新记录必须唯一、completed且success。旧失败不能覆盖新成功，最新失败/排队/取消/跳过不能沿用旧成功；缺检查、重复最新记录均拒绝。其他提交的绿色记录不能填补当前候选证据。
平台创建两个各自smoke通过但合并后失败的真实Git分支，实际运行Python smoke生成结果；再重建能通过的合并候选，并推进目标基线检验旧证据失效。lint记录作为可信教学采集记录提供，本题不实现CI签名认证或GitHub API。此函数仅判合并资格，不实际合并目标分支、不部署或删除历史批准记录。

## 产物
merge_gate.py及逐候选合并资格判断。

## 验收方法
实际Git merge及真实smoke结果驱动门禁；不把PR检查记录误当最终队列对象证据。

import copy,importlib.util,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd();spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission',ROOT/'merge_gate.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='actual merge queue ') as d:
    root=pathlib.Path(d);repo=root/'repo';repo.mkdir();env={**os.environ,'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':os.devnull,'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1','GIT_AUTHOR_NAME':'Fixture','GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL':'fixture@example.invalid','GIT_COMMITTER_NAME':'Fixture','GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL':'fixture@example.invalid'}
    def git(*args):
        r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr;return r.stdout.strip()
    def edit(path,text): (repo/path).write_text(text,encoding='utf8')
    def commit(message):git('add','-A');git('commit','-qm',message);return git('rev-parse','HEAD')
    git('init','-q','-b','main');edit('limit.py','LIMIT = 10\n');edit('usage.py','USED = 2\n');edit('smoke.py','from limit import LIMIT\nfrom usage import USED\nassert USED <= LIMIT\n');origin=commit('original')
    git('checkout','-qb','pr');edit('usage.py','USED = 8\n');pr=commit('PR more usage');git('checkout','-q','main');edit('limit.py','LIMIT = 5\n');base=commit('base smaller capacity')
    git('checkout','-qb','queue',base);git('merge','--no-ff','-m','queue combined','pr');bad=git('rev-parse','HEAD')
    def smoke(oid,run_id):
        target=root/('run-'+str(run_id));target.mkdir()
        for name in ['limit.py','usage.py','smoke.py']:(target/name).write_text(git('show',oid+':'+name),encoding='utf8')
        proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','smoke.py'],cwd=target,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
        return {'sha':oid,'name':'smoke','run_id':run_id,'status':'completed','conclusion':'success' if proc.returncode==0 else 'failure'}
    base_record=smoke(base,1);pr_record=smoke(pr,2);bad_record=smoke(bad,3);assert base_record['conclusion']==pr_record['conclusion']=='success' and bad_record['conclusion']=='failure','fixture must reproduce actual combined-only regression'
    def gate(candidate,records,pr_oid=pr,base_oid=base):return m.eligible(str(repo),'refs/heads/main',base_oid,pr_oid,candidate,['smoke','lint'],copy.deepcopy(records))
    lint=lambda oid,n: {'sha':oid,'name':'lint','run_id':n,'status':'completed','conclusion':'success'}
    assert gate(bad,[base_record,pr_record,lint(pr,4)]) is False,'PR green is not merge evidence'
    assert gate(bad,[base_record,pr_record,bad_record,lint(bad,4)]) is False,'actual combined smoke failure ignored'
    # A rebuilt PR changes source and produces a distinct passing merge candidate.
    git('checkout','-qb','pr-fixed',origin);edit('usage.py','USED = 4\n');fixed=commit('compatible usage');git('checkout','-qb','queue-fixed',base);git('merge','--no-ff','-m','rebuild queue','pr-fixed');good=git('rev-parse','HEAD');ok=smoke(good,5);assert ok['conclusion']=='success';valid=[ok,lint(good,6)]
    assert gate(good,valid,pr_oid=fixed) is True
    assert gate(good,[bad_record,lint(bad,8)],pr_oid=fixed) is False,'old queue evidence reused'
